title: Remote approval
responsibility: Lets a computer user grant selected projects and optional agent permission to a requesting phone.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.request
inputs.description: Carries the requesting phone's device name, platform, device ID, pairing ID, and request/expiry timestamps; the component displays the name, platform, and a label derived from the device ID, then passes both IDs to approval and the pairing ID to denial. The component does not read the timestamps; approval is disabled while busy or until at least one project is selected.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.projects
inputs.description: Provides the projects shown as checkboxes, using each id as both the keyed-list key and approval value and each name as its label. No project is selected initially, and an empty list leaves Approve disabled while showing the local-project note.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.store
inputs.description: Provides busy state and the approve and deny calls used by the component. The component invokes those calls without awaiting or handling their results.

outputs.name: RemoteApproval
outputs.description: Renders request identity, project checkboxes, a device-access selector, and Approve and Deny buttons; selection starts empty and access starts at comment, with Approve disabled while busy or without a selected project and Deny disabled while busy. Approval sends both request IDs, selected project IDs, and flags where only write enables agents and every value except read enables comments.

errors.name: Duplicate row key
errors.description: The keyed project list uses each item.id as its key, so duplicate project IDs can throw Svelte's duplicate-key error.
